T1110_001_Password_Guessing.description: Standard brute force. Multiple failed logins from a single IP.

T1110_003_Password_Spraying.description: Slow, methodical login failures targeting a specific user account over a longer period to avoid lockout thresholds.

T1078_Valid_Accounts_Compromise.description: A user fails to login multiple times, followed immediately by a successful login. Highly indicative of a successful brute force.

T1566_Phishing_Link_Click.description: User clicks a link in an email and immediately downloads a file.

T1204_002_Malicious_File_Execution.description: User downloads a payload and executes it shortly after.

T1059_001_PowerShell_Execution.description: Rapid execution of multiple PowerShell commands by a single user.

T1053_Scheduled_Task_Creation.description: Execution of a file followed by the creation of a scheduled task for persistence.

T1136_Create_Account_PrivEsc.description: A user executes a command, creates a new user account, and immediately adds it to an admin group.

T1003_Credential_Dumping.description: User accesses the LSASS process or registry keys associated with credentials.

T1021_001_RDP_Lateral_Movement.description: An IP establishes multiple RDP connections to different hosts in rapid succession.

T1021_002_SMB_Share_Discovery.description: Rapid enumeration or access of multiple network shares.

T1048_Exfiltration_Over_Alternative_Prot.description: Massive data upload sequence from a single IP, indicating data exfiltration.

T1567_Exfiltration_to_Cloud_Storage.description: User archives data (zips) and immediately uploads it.

T1486_Ransomware_Encryption_Spike.description: Rapid succession of file modifications or encryptions by a single user account.

T1485_Data_Destruction_Wiper.description: A massive spike in file deletion events, indicating a wiper malware or malicious insider.

T1071_Standard_Application_Layer_Protoco.description: Consistent, repetitive outbound network connections indicating C2 beaconing.

T1070_Indicator_Removal_on_Host.description: User executes a command and then clears the system event logs.

T1112_Modify_Registry_Defense_Evasion.description: Rapid modifications to system registry keys associated with security tools (e.g., disabling antivirus).
